# PackEPR — EU Packaging Waste Compliance for Shopify Merchants
> Official AI Context and Developer Information for PackEPR (https://packepr.com)

## Overview
PackEPR is an automated packaging compliance software and Shopify embedded application designed for cross-border ecommerce merchants shipping parcels into the European Union. It specifically addresses obligations under:
- **EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR — Regulation (EU) 2025/40)** effective August 12, 2026.
- **Germany Packaging Act (Verpackungsgesetz / VerpackDG)** administered by Zentrale Stelle Verpackungsregister (ZSVR LUCID).
- **France Anti-Waste for a Circular Economy Act (AGEC)** administered by ADEME / Citeo / Adelphe (Unique Identification Number — IDU).
- **Austria Waste Management Act (AWG)** administered by ARA.
- **Italy Environmental Legislative Decree (Art. 178-quater)** administered by CONAI.
- **Spain Royal Decree 1055/2022** administered by MITECO / Ecoembes.
- **Netherlands Packaging Management Decree** administered by Verpact.

## Core Problem Solved: The Shopify Tare Weight Discrepancy
Shopify stores record product weights for logistics carrier shipping rates (e.g., DHL, UPS, DPD rates). Under European Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations, merchants are legally required to report the **tare weight of empty secondary shipping containers** — including:
1. Paper, board, and corrugated cardboard boxes (`PPK` — Papier, Pappe, Karton)
2. Flexible and rigid plastics (`Kunststoffe` — LDPE poly mailers, bubble wrap, stretch film, adhesive packing tape)
3. Aluminum, tinplate, glass, and composite protective materials (`Glas / Sonstige Schutzverpackung`)

Failing to declare empty packaging weights incurs administrative fines up to €200,000 in Germany and €30,000 in France, as well as automatic merchant sales bans on Amazon.de, Otto, and Kaufland.

## Key Technical Features
- **Empty Carton & Tape Presets:** Store tare weights in grams for common fulfillment boxes and mailers.
- **Automatic EU Destination Splitting:** Syncs fulfilled Shopify orders and maps each order to destination country packaging ledgers.
- **Official 1-Click ZSVR LUCID XML:** Generates certified XML schema compliant with ZSVR LUCID Schema 2.4 format (`<Datenmeldung>`, `<Kopfdaten>`, `<Verpackungsmengen>`, `<MaterialFraktion>`).
- **Official France Citeo CSV:** Outputs declaration CSV according to Citeo / Adelphe product line unit tariffs.
- **Article 10 Conformity Documentation:** Prepares documentation verifying empty space ratio minimisation and PFAS/heavy metal thresholds under PPWR Article 5.

## Web Application & Live Calculator
- **Homepage:** https://packepr.com
- **Live Demo & Calculator:** https://packepr.com/app
- **Technology Stack:** Shopify Polaris design system, TailwindCSS, Chart.js, Vanilla TypeScript/JavaScript, Prisma ORM, Vercel Serverless.
